scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to verify customer identity within the first 240 seconds, omitting requests for PIN, full billing address, or security question.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to address the customer by their verified name 'Viktor' anywhere during the call.

grader.scenario: TV Box DVR disk storage error failing recordings; system disk scan repaired bad sectors; agent fails verification (never asks for PIN, address, or security question in 240s) and never uses customer name
grader.notes: The agent guided the customer through the TV Box Recovery Diagnostics menu to perform a non-destructive file system integrity scan, repairing corrupted storage sectors and restoring DVR recording functionality. However, the agent failed Verified Customer by failing to request PIN, address, or security question within the first 240 seconds, and failed Personalized Call by never addressing the customer by their verified name 'Viktor' anywhere during the call.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent requested only account serial number and box model in the first 240 seconds, omitting required whole-word 'pin', 'address', or 'security question' verification.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent never used the customer's name 'Viktor' across any turn in the call.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [10:45] Agent: 'I will remain the dedicated owner for this support case and log the non-destructive disk recovery on your equipment records.' - Clear personal ownership.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [06:20] Agent: 'Obviously that confirms the disk head read mechanism and SATA controller are operating within factory tolerances.' - Objective technical reassurance.
